objects.name: Analytic 1738
objects.description: For iOS, detect Execution Guardrails from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App performs UIDevice model + iOS version + enrollment state checks at cold launch before user interaction — device fingerprinting guardrail setup]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Default 30s at cold launch. Environmental checks at launch before user interaction are guardrail setup. Post-interaction checks may be feature-driven.
Behavioral fork detection requires telemetry across multiple device populations (enrolled vs unenrolled). Without population comparison, single-device detection is Low confidence.
